headline: Microsoft's November Windows update breaks printing for some users
summary: Microsoft's November 2026 security updates for Windows are causing printing problems, including issues triggered by zero-size graphics, and some administrators have also reported activation failures. Microsoft said the updates may break printing specifically for documents with complex formatting.
